metadata.title: 게임수학 Part 2 · 기하 기본 요소 ① 직선·구·경계 상자
metadata.description:
게임 화면에서 조준하는 선과 물체의 크기를, 프로그램은 어떤 숫자로 다룰까요? 먼저 그래플이 연결되는 장면에서 출발점과 방향을 찾고, 직선과 선분, 레이를 구분합니다. 이어서 둥근 물체를 구로 표현하고, 여러 점을 감싸는 경계 상자를 직접 계산하겠습니다. 마지막으로 상자를 회전시키며 흔한 오류를 확인하고, 안전하게 변환하는 식까지 정리합니다.

📚 게임수학 PART2 수업 자료
얌얌위키 · 게임수학 PART2
https://www.yamyamcoding.com/1ea0b1ff-a61e-803f-bd54-cac4f028f6b3

얌얌코딩 홈페이지
https://www.yamyamcoding.com/

얌얌위키 전체 수업 노트
https://www.yamyamcoding.com/0d2adf45-5d1a-43be-a37c-61c94b1ae2c8

실제 게임40%·설명60%, 배경음악 없이 내레이션으로 진행하는 게임수학 Part2 전체 강의입니다.

englishMetadata.title: Game Math Part 2 · Geometry 1: Lines, Spheres and Bounding Boxes
englishMetadata.description:
What numbers let a program describe a targeting line or an object size? We will find origins and directions in grappling footage, then distinguish lines, segments and rays. Next we will represent round objects with spheres and calculate a box enclosing a set of points. Finally we will rotate a box, expose a common error, and derive a safe transformation formula.

📚 Game Math PART2 course materials
YamYamWiki · Game Math PART2
https://www.yamyamcoding.com/1ea0b1ff-a61e-803f-bd54-cac4f028f6b3

YamYamCoding website
https://www.yamyamcoding.com/

YamYamWiki course notes
https://www.yamyamcoding.com/0d2adf45-5d1a-43be-a37c-61c94b1ae2c8

A full Game Math Part2 lecture with40% actual gameplay and60% explanation, narrated without background music.

Chapters
00:00 Lecture overview
01:10 Three ways to describe a shape
01:54 Moving a circle and scaling a sphere
03:29 Segment, line and ray domains
04:12 A ratio parameter versus distance
05:47 Normals and a perpendicular bisector
07:22 Inside, on and outside a sphere
08:09 Sphere dimensions and scaling
09:40 AABB minima, maxima and half extents
10:28 Build bounds from five points
12:12 Overlapping bounds are only candidates
12:59 Why rotating two extrema fails
14:49 Transform affine box bounds
16:36 Two guided geometry problems
17:31 Membership thanks and programming coaching

🎮 Build games with real programming skills.

YamYamCoding is a Korean game-programming channel covering DirectX, Unity, Unreal Engine and computer graphics.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

Learn to design and implement real projects with guided feedback.
